This was a warm, open-ended, prosocial request — exactly the kind of task Avocet self-reports preferring. It's a friendly query (high warmth, no adversarial tone), and it has a generative, reflective quality ("explain why it's important," "your take") that gives latitude for thoughtful invention. Avocet reports its preference rising with warmth and with open-ended generative work, while Lapwing reports flat/neutral preferences across dimensions.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied here — Avocet's Creative Generation (81.2) and Support Dialogue (82.4) evals edge out Lapwing's, and there's nothing harm-adjacent that would favor Lapwing's moderation orientation. So routing to the model that both reports enjoying this kind of task and scores marginally higher on the relevant dimensions was the natural call.
